## Problem

What concrete problem or workflow limitation should be solved?

## Proposed capability

Describe the smallest useful capability, not only an implementation preference.

## Governance impact

Explain any effect on authority, policy, evidence/provenance, provider independence, persistent state, recovery, or external actions.

## Alternatives

What simpler or safer approaches were considered?

## Acceptance evidence

What tests, observable outcomes, or adversarial cases would demonstrate that this is complete without weakening governance?
